mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, board_type AS boardType, author_member_id AS authorMemberId, title, content, readcount, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM BOARD_POST WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.board_type AS categoryName, p.title, p.content, p.readcount AS viewCount, p.created_at, u.user_name AS writerNickname,
LEFT(p.content, 120) AS excerpt,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount,
0 AS likeCount
FROM BOARD_POST p JOIN USER u ON p.author_member_id = u.user_id
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND p.board_type = #{category}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
AND p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') )
ORDER BY
p.readcount DESC
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) DESC
p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{page.offset}, #{page.safeSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_POST p
WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND p.board_type = #{category}
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') )

SELECT file_id AS fileId, category_idx AS categoryIdx, origin_name AS originName, stored_name AS storedName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_ext AS fileExt, reg_date AS createdAt FROM uploaded_file WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY file_id ASC
